title: The Ledger Counted Pending Work
subject: DBMS
briefing: The finance report should total only transactions whose status is posted. Pending transactions have not committed and must not affect the report.
symptom: The displayed total includes money from transactions that are still pending.
hints: Check which transaction statuses contribute to the reported sum.
A pending transaction is not the same as a posted transaction.
Include a row only when its status is exactly posted.
